verdict.what_is_wrong: A slow-MySQL-response signature is present: mysqld connection-gap p50s rose from 0.3–0.4 ms in the baseline sample to about 58–66 ms in the later sample while thousands of answers still arrived. The mysqld process itself showed little CPU or disk strain, so the likely delay is in the proxy/path to MySQL rather than a database resource bottleneck; exact client-to-accepted-socket mapping was not established.
